//: Example brief for `python manage.py seed_site --brief <this>`. The /seed-site skill produces a filled copy per customer under seed_assets/briefs/<host>.json. Run `manage.py fetch_seed_images --brief <this>` FIRST: it searches each record's `image_query` on Pexels (falling back to Pixabay), downloads into seed_assets/fetched/<host>/, writes the filenames back into `image`, and records each photo's credit so seed_site can store it. Write every image_query in ENGLISH and describe the SUBJECT plus a shared visual register - never the record's own name, which for a product like 'Acme Mover M1' or a dish like 'Hawaiana' searches as nothing useful. Any `image` value is a filename relative to seed_assets/ (omit it and, with no fetch, the placeholder-* pool fills in). Only video_link + href are real URLs. Fill en_* fields for the English mirror; leave them out to skip.
